card.name: The end of immune globulin
card.fires_on: The final piece "ulin" of the word globulin, mainly in "immune globulin" (IG, VZIG, IGIV) in warnings about exposure or infusion. It also fires weakly on "access" after "venous".

modes.label: Immune globulin
modes.description: The ending "ulin" completes "globulin" right after "immune" or "immuno".

modes.label: Venous access
modes.description: The word "access" follows "venous" in advice about infusion site care.
